name: plugin.headroom_context_optimizer
description: Adaptive context optimization layer for autonomous agent steps with content routing, SmartCrusher, CCR deduplication, and cache drift detection
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: headroom_compress_content
entrypoints.description: Route and compress arbitrary content (code, JSON, logs, diffs, text) using AST and format-aware compressors

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: Optional content type hint (code, json, log, diff, search, text)

parameters.name: preserve_keys
parameters.description: Keys to unconditionally preserve when compacting JSON

entrypoints.name: headroom_dedup_turns
entrypoints.description: Cross-Context Retrieval (CCR): Deduplicate repeating tool returns and observations across conversation turns

parameters.name: min_lines
parameters.description: Minimum line count threshold to fold into a digest marker (default: 3)

entrypoints.name: headroom_detect_cache_drift
entrypoints.description: Inspect system prompt for volatile elements (UUIDs, timestamps, hashes) that bust prompt cache prefixes

entrypoints.name: headroom_compact_thinking
entrypoints.description: Compact prior-turn extended thinking reasoning blocks into deterministic summarized markers

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: List of conversation messages containing thinking blocks

parameters.name: keep_last_turns
parameters.description: Number of recent assistant turns to leave thinking blocks intact (default: 2)

entrypoints.name: headroom_savings_metrics
entrypoints.description: Inspect session context savings, trimmed tokens, and compression ledger

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: Whether to reset the active session savings ledger (default: false)
